other_conditions: Must be a resident of a district of Andhra Pradesh
Must not be covered under any other Pension Scheme
Must be destitute with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon
Eligibility identified by respective Ward Sabhas
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly pension to eligible destitute elderly persons aged 65 and above in urban areas of Andhra Pradesh; the pension amount is to be notified by the government.
